text: Thanks Sam! Now Jamie, rugby league fans are getting properly pumped up because State of Origin Game One is just days away next Wednesday night at Stadium Australia. The build-up's been intense with both NSW and Queensland squads looking absolutely stacked with talent for what could be one of the best series in years.

speaker: alice
text: The rivalry never gets old Alex! And in American college sports, the NCAA Women's College World Series is delivering some absolute crackers of games. We're seeing some marathon battles going into extra innings with Nebraska and Arkansas putting on a show for the ages. The level of skill and determination from these young athletes is just phenomenal.

speaker: charlie
text: Speaking of phenomenal, Formula One heads to Mugello this weekend for the Gran Premio d'Italia, and with the season heating up, every point matters. Plus our own A-League season wrapped up with some outstanding officiating improvements - they successfully introduced new elite officials and made major advances in VAR technology. Good to see Australian football continuing to lift its standards across the board.
